en: Black‑and‑white illustrated postcard showing a large, ornate late‑19th‑century/early‑20th‑century villa or hotel in a forested setting. The multi‑storey building has steep gabled roofs, half‑timbered façades and several small towers with weather vanes, in a Central European historicist style. A glassed‑in veranda or café wraps around the ground floor. In the foreground, a well‑dressed couple and a child with a dog walk along a wide road. On a post near the entrance are several signs advertising the establishment. Dense woods and a small bridge path recede into the background.
